items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs flip negative for 2026 after $1.28 billion outflow week, worst since June
items.summary: BlackRock's IBIT accounted for 98% of Friday's outflows, with $403 million leaving the industry-leading fund.

items.title: Thailand is cutting off Bitget. Users have until December 5 to prepare
items.summary: The regulator asks customers to consider action on holdings before the block, while Bitget promises guidance on service access.

items.title: Treasury Cuts Crypto Exchange MEXC Off From US Financial System
items.summary: FinCEN's order bars U.S. institutions from any transfers to or from MEXC, which Treasury says facilitated $16 billion in illicit finance.

items.title: Thailand SEC Files Criminal Complaint Against Bitget Ahead of Dec. 5 Access Block
items.summary: Thailand's SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget operator BG Limited for unlicensed Thai trading.

items.title: U.S. Treasury moves to cut off crypto exchange MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows
items.summary: Treasury billed the move as part of its campaign against Iran, but the order rests on MEXC's alleged role in Russian illicit finance.
